responsibility: This module implements the Rust frontend’s abstract syntax tree subsystem: it defines the core AST node model for crates, items, expressions, statements, patterns, paths, types, macros, attributes, conditional-compilation metadata, and a few builtin/special nodes such as `format_args!`, then supplies the shared infrastructure needed to work on that tree through visitors, cloning, stringification, dumping, formatting, token re-collection, and fragment containers for macro expansion results. Beyond representing parsed Rust syntax, it also hosts early AST-to-AST normalization passes and support utilities that make later semantic stages possible, including collection of `#[lang]` items, builtin macro classification, programmatic AST builders, type-cloning helpers, and desugarings for high-level Rust constructs such as argument-position `impl Trait`, `for` loops, `while let`, `try` blocks, and the `?` operator. As a result, this module is the Rust frontend’s source-level syntax representation and early rewrite layer, distinct from parsing on one side and HIR/lowering or later semantic analysis on the other.
